title: POST /api/broker/{broker}/logout (200)
description: Confirmation that ONE broker's session was dropped. Source: src/brokerAuthRoutes.ts POST /api/broker/:broker/logout success branch. Obtained via REAL HTTP with an inert BrokerLoginProvider. Scoped to the named broker: the other broker's stored session, feed and subscriptions are untouched. Carries no session detail at all — the caller re-reads GET /api/broker/status for the new state.
